title: core.org.updated
description: An organization's settings changed. `changed` names the columns the update touched. `timezone`, `currency` and `fiscal_year_start_month` are the values *after* the change and are always present, so a projection that buckets by the organization's local day converges on the next event without reading account back. `name` and `country` travel only when `changed` names them (null otherwise) — the identity fields console's own directory fold has no other route back to (ADR-0000 §10: no cross-schema reads).
